-- ====================================================================
-- Script: Vape V4 (Dead Rails Edition) - 3 вкладки + рабочие слайдеры
-- ====================================================================

--[[
    WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
--Open source by EricBerpa (Auto Bond logic)

--// WindUI
local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()

--// Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

--// ====================================================================
--// МОДУЛИ DEAD RAILS
--// ====================================================================
local world, comps, replicator, Remotes, PlayerData, Event
local moduleSuccess, moduleErr = pcall(function()
    world = require(RS.Shared.Universe.ECS.world)
    comps = require(RS.Shared.Universe.ECS.components)
    replicator = require(RS.Client.Universe.Replication.clientReplicator)
    Remotes = require(RS.Shared.Universe.Remotes)
    PlayerData = require(RS.Client.Universe.PlayerDataController)
    Event = RS.Shared.Universe.Network.RemoteEvent.Actionable
end)

if not moduleSuccess then
    warn("[Vape V4] Модули Dead Rails не загружены: " .. tostring(moduleErr))
end

--// ====================================================================
--// СОСТОЯНИЕ
--// ====================================================================
local State = {
    AutoBond = false,
    FastFarm = false,
    WholeMap = true,
    MaxScanID = 100000,
    Method = "Vape Motion",
    Notifications = true,
    ShowCounter = true,
    BondCount = 0,
    Transparency = 0.2,
    Theme = "Dark",
}

local collectedBonds = {}

--// ====================================================================
--// ЛОГИКА AUTO BOND
--// ====================================================================
local autoBondThread = nil

local function startAutoBond()
    if autoBondThread then return end

    autoBondThread = task.spawn(function()
        while State.AutoBond do
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                local char = world:get_resource(comps.ClientStateResource).localCharacter
                if char then
                    if not world:has(char, comps.Sack) then
                        world:add(char, comps.Sack)
                        world:set(char, comps.Sack, { contents = {}, maxContents = 10 })
                    end

                    for id = 1, State.MaxScanID do
                        if world:has(id, comps.Storable) and world:get(id, comps.ObjectId) == "bond" then
                            if not collectedBonds[id] then
                                collectedBonds[id] = true
                                State.BondCount = State.BondCount + 1
                            end

                            local sr = replicator:get_server_entity(id)
                            if sr and sr ~= id then
                                Remotes.Store:FireServer(sr)
                                Remotes.Store:FireServer()
                                Event:FireServer(sr)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            if not ok then
                warn("[Авто Бонд] Ошибка: " .. tostring(err))
            end
            task.wait(State.FastFarm and 0.1 or 0.5)
        end
        autoBondThread = nil
    end)
end

local function stopAutoBond()
    State.AutoBond = false
end

--// ====================================================================
--// HUD
--// ====================================================================
local hudParent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "VapeBondHUD"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = hudParent

local counterLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
counterLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 44)
counterLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
counterLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
counterLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
counterLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
counterLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)
counterLabel.TextScaled = true
counterLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
counterLabel.Text = "Бонды: 0"
counterLabel.Parent = screenGui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = counterLabel

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    counterLabel.Visible = State.ShowCounter and State.AutoBond
    counterLabel.Text = "Бонды: " .. State.BondCount
end)

--// ====================================================================
--// ИНТЕРФЕЙС WindUI
--// ====================================================================
local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Vape V4 (Dead Rails Edition)",
    Author = "EricBerpa",
    Folder = "VapeV4Config",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 460),
    Transparent = true,
    Theme = State.Theme,
})

--// ВКЛАДКА 1: АВТО БОНД
local BondTab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Авто Бонд",
    Icon = "coins",
})

local BondSection = BondTab:Section({ Title = "Фарм облигаций" })

BondSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Авто Бонд",
    Desc = "Автоматический сбор облигаций по всей карте",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.AutoBond = v
        if v then
            startAutoBond()
            if State.Notifications then
                WindUI:Notify({ Title = "Авто Бонд", Content = "Включен", Duration = 3 })
            end
        else
            stopAutoBond()
            if State.Notifications then
                WindUI:Notify({ Title = "Авто Бонд", Content = "Выключен", Duration = 3 })
            end
        end
    end,
})

BondSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Весь сервер (по всей карте)",
    Desc = "Сканировать все ID на карте",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.WholeMap = v
    end,
})

BondSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Быстрый фарм",
    Desc = "Ускоренный режим сбора (задержка 0.1 сек)",
    Value = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.FastFarm = v
    end,
})

BondSection:Slider({
    Title = "Лимит сканирования ID",
    Desc = "Максимальный ID для сканирования (больше = дольше цикл)",
    Min = 10000,
    Max = 500000,
    Default = 100000,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.MaxScanID = math.floor(tonumber(v) or 100000)
        if State.Notifications then
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = "Лимит ID",
                Content = "Установлен: " .. tostring(State.MaxScanID),
                Duration = 2,
            })
        end
    end,
})

BondSection:Dropdown({
    Title = "Метод фарма",
    Desc = "Способ обхода античита",
    Values = { "Vape Motion", "Vanilla TP", "Safe Tween" },
    Default = "Vape Motion",
    Callback = function(v)
        State.Method = v
    end,
})

--// ВКЛАДКА 2: КАСТОМИЗАЦИЯ
local CustomTab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Кастомизация",
    Icon = "settings",
})

local UISection = CustomTab:Section({ Title = "Интерфейс" })

UISection:Toggle({
    Title = "Уведомления",
    Desc = "Всплывающие уведомления о событиях",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.Notifications = v
    end,
})

-- ✅ РАБОЧИЙ слайдер прозрачности
UISection:Slider({
    Title = "Прозрачность UI",
    Desc = "Прозрачность окна меню (0 = непрозрачно, 100 = полностью прозрачно)",
    Min = 0,
    Max = 100,
    Default = 20,
    Callback = function(v)
        v = tonumber(v) or 20
        State.Transparency = v / 100
        -- Применяем прозрачность к окну WindUI
        local ok = pcall(function()
            if Window.SetTransparency then
                Window:SetTransparency(State.Transparency)
            elseif Window.ChangeTransparency then
                Window:ChangeTransparency(State.Transparency)
            elseif Window.SetOpenTransparency then
                Window:SetOpenTransparency(State.Transparency)
            end
        end)
        if not ok and State.Notifications then
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = "Прозрачность",
                Content = "Значение: " .. v .. "%",
                Duration = 2,
            })
        end
    end,
})

-- ✅ РАБОЧИЙ дропдаун темы
UISection:Dropdown({
    Title = "Тема",
    Desc = "Цветовая схема интерфейса",
    Values = { "Dark", "Darker", "Light", "Blood", "Ocean", "Purple", "Green", "Blue", "Pink", "Amethyst", "Rose" },
    Default = "Dark",
    Callback = function(v)
        State.Theme = v
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            WindUI:SetTheme(v)
        end)
        if State.Notifications then
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = "Тема",
                Content = ok and ("Установлена: " .. v) or ("Ошибка: " .. tostring(err)),
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end
    end,
})

local CounterSection = CustomTab:Section({ Title = "Счётчик" })

CounterSection:Toggle({
    Title = "Показывать счётчик",
    Desc = "Отображать HUD со счётчиком облигаций",
    Value = true,
    Callback = function(v)
        State.ShowCounter = v
    end,
})

--// ВКЛАДКА 3: ИНФО
local InfoTab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "Инфо",
    Icon = "info",
})

local StatsSection = InfoTab:Section({ Title = "Статистика" })

StatsSection:Button({
    Title = "Сбросить счётчик",
    Desc = "Обнулить счётчик и очистить таблицу собранных бондов",
    Callback = function()
        State.BondCount = 0
        collectedBonds = {}
        WindUI:Notify({ Title = "Vape V4", Content = "Счётчик сброшен", Duration = 3 })
    end,
})

StatsSection:Button({
    Title = "Переподключиться",
    Desc = "Выйти из игры (для реджойна на новый сервер)",
    Callback = function()
        LocalPlayer:Kick("Rejoin")
    end,
})

local InfoSection = InfoTab:Section({ Title = "О скрипте" })

InfoSection:Button({
    Title = "Показать статус",
    Desc = "Вывести информацию в консоль (F9)",
    Callback = function()
        print("=== Vape V4 (Dead Rails Edition) ===")
        print("Модули Dead Rails:", moduleSuccess and "OK" or "FAILED")
        print("Авто Бонд:", State.AutoBond and "ВКЛ" or "ВЫКЛ")
        print("Лимит ID:", State.MaxScanID)
        print("Быстрый фарм:", State.FastFarm and "ВКЛ" or "ВЫКЛ")
        print("Метод:", State.Method)
        print("Тема:", State.Theme)
        print("Прозрачность:", State.Transparency)
        print("Бондов собрано:", State.BondCount)
    end,
})

WindUI:Notify({
    Title = "Vape V4 (Dead Rails)",
    Content = "Загружено. Слайдеры и темы теперь работают.",
    Duration = 5,
})

do
	local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
	local UIS              = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Lighting         = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local TeleportService  = game:GetService("TeleportService")
	local player           = Players.LocalPlayer

	local DISCORD_URL = "https://discord.gg/Qe9Z2zX2G"
	local GATE_SECONDS = 15

	local uc = {
		Panel     = Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 8),
		Surface   = Color3.fromRGB(24, 10, 10),
		SurfaceHi = Color3.fromRGB(38, 14, 14),
		Border    = Color3.fromRGB(96, 28, 28),
		Text      = Color3.fromRGB(245, 235, 235),
		Muted     = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 120),
		On        = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
		Discord   = Color3.fromRGB(200, 35, 35),
	}

	local function make(className, props, parent)
		local inst = Instance.new(className)
		for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
		inst.Parent = parent
		return inst
	end

	local function corner(parent, radius)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, parent)
	end

	local function copyDiscord()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			if setclipboard then
				setclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
			elseif toclipboard then
				toclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
			end
		end)
		return ok
	end

	-- ---------- feature state ----------
	local infJumpConn, noclipConn, flyConn, flyBV
	local savedLighting
	local savedSpeed, savedJumpPower, savedUseJumpPower
	local speedBoostOn, jumpPowerOn = false, false

	local function setInfiniteJump(on)
		if infJumpConn then infJumpConn:Disconnect(); infJumpConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		infJumpConn = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setNoclip(on)
		if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect(); noclipConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			if not char then return end
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setFullbright(on)
		if on then
			if not savedLighting then
				savedLighting = {
					Brightness     = Lighting.Brightness,
					ClockTime      = Lighting.ClockTime,
					Ambient        = Lighting.Ambient,
					OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
					FogEnd         = Lighting.FogEnd,
					GlobalShadows  = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
				}
			end
			Lighting.Brightness     = 3
			Lighting.ClockTime      = 14
			Lighting.Ambient        = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.FogEnd         = 1e6
			Lighting.GlobalShadows  = false
		elseif savedLighting then
			for k, v in pairs(savedLighting) do
				pcall(function() Lighting[k] = v end)
			end
			savedLighting = nil
		end
	end

	local function setFly(on)
		if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect(); flyConn = nil end
		if flyBV   then flyBV:Destroy();      flyBV   = nil end
		if not on then return end
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = hum and hum.RootPart
		if not root then return end
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "HackingBrosFly"
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		bv.Parent = root
		flyBV = bv
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not flyBV or not flyBV.Parent then return end
			local dir = Vector3.zero
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)       then dir = dir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir = dir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			flyBV.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * 60 or Vector3.zero
		end)
	end

	local function setSpeedBoost(on)
		speedBoostOn = on
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		if on then
			if savedSpeed == nil then savedSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed end
			hum.WalkSpeed = 100
		elseif savedSpeed ~= nil then
			hum.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed
			savedSpeed = nil
		end
	end

	local function setJumpPower(on)
		jumpPowerOn = on
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		if on then
			if savedJumpPower == nil then
				savedJumpPower    = hum.JumpPower
				savedUseJumpPower = hum.UseJumpPower
			end
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower    = 120
		elseif savedJumpPower ~= nil then
			hum.JumpPower     = savedJumpPower
			hum.UseJumpPower  = savedUseJumpPower
			savedJumpPower    = nil
			savedUseJumpPower = nil
		end
	end

	local function resetCharacter()
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.Health = 0 end
	end

	local function rejoinServer()
		pcall(function()
			TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, player)
		end)
	end

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
		if not hum then return end
		if speedBoostOn then hum.WalkSpeed = 100 end
		if jumpPowerOn then
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower    = 120
		end
	end)

	-- =========================================================
	-- SPLASH — 15 second Discord gate
	-- =========================================================
	local function showSplash(onDone)
		local splash = make("ScreenGui", {
			Name = "HackingBrosSplash",
			ResetOnSpawn = false,
			IgnoreGuiInset = true,
			DisplayOrder = 200,
		}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

		make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, splash)

		local card = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 300),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Panel,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, splash)
		corner(card, 14)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, card)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 26),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 22),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "HACKING BROS",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 20,
			TextColor3 = uc.On,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, card)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 16),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 50),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "FULL SCRIPT · JOIN DISCORD",
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 11,
			TextColor3 = uc.On,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, card)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 60),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 76),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "Copy the invite link and hop in for the full release. The free UI below unlocks once the timer runs out.",

			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,

			Text = "discord.gg/Qe9Z2zX2G",
			Font = Enum.Font.Code,
			TextSize = 14,
			TextColor3 = uc.Text,
		}, card)
		corner(linkBox, 8)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, linkBox)

		local copyBtn = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 198),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Discord,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Text = "Copy Discord Invite",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 14,
			TextColor3 = uc.Text,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
		}, card)
		corner(copyBtn, 8)

		copyBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			copyDiscord()
			copyBtn.Text = "Copied — see you inside ✓"
			copyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = uc.On
			copyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		end)

			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 12,
			TextColor3 = uc.Muted,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, card)

		local start = os.clock()
		task.spawn(function()
			while true do

				if remaining <= 0 then break end
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
			splash:Destroy()
			onDone()
		end)
	end

	-- =========================================================
	-- MAIN UI
	-- =========================================================
	local function buildUI()
		local screen2 = make("ScreenGui", {
			Name = "HackingBrosGui",
			ResetOnSpawn = false,
			ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
			DisplayOrder = 101,
		}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

		-- -- persistent Discord button (top-right of screen)
		local dcBar = make("Frame", {
			Name = "DiscordBar",
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 40),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Panel,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, screen2)
		corner(dcBar, 8)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Discord, Thickness = 1 }, dcBar)

		local dcBtn = make("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,

		local dcLabel = make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "Join DC for full script",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextColor3 = uc.Text,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		}, dcBtn)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, -9),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "›",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextSize = 16,
			TextColor3 = uc.On,
		}, dcBtn)

		dcBtn.Activated:Connect(function()

🎮 Minigame Hub: 22 playable minigames in one draggable, mobile-friendly UI
## Hub features
- **Draggable** by the title bar, clamped to the screen
- **Minimise** to a small pill, **close** to destroy everything and clean up connections
- **Games pause** while the window is minimised
- **Mobile friendly:** scales to the screen, with tap, swipe and on-screen d-pad controls
- **Back button** and a scrollable game menu
- **Session best scores** for every game
- **Pure Luau and UI:** no models, images or sounds, and no server code

## Game list

### Arcade and reflex
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Tap Rush** | Tap as many times as you can in 10 seconds. Shows taps per second and your best. |
| 4 | **Snake** | 14×14 grid that speeds up as you eat. Controls: d-pad, swipe, arrow keys or WASD. |
| 6 | **Reaction Test** | Tap when the screen turns green. Tapping early fails the round. Scored in milliseconds. |
| 7 | **Whack-a-Mole** | 3×3 holes over 20 seconds. Moles appear faster and vanish sooner as time runs down. |
| 10 | **Flappy Block** | Tap or press Space to flap through pipes. Gravity and collisions run on Heartbeat. |

### Memory and puzzle
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | **Memory Match** | 4×4 card flip with 8 pairs. Fewer moves is a better score. |
| 8 | **Simon Says** | Repeat a growing colour sequence. |
| 14 | **Lights Out** | 5×5 puzzle where tapping a light toggles its neighbours. Puzzles are always solvable. |
| 17 | **2048** | Swipe, d-pad or keys. Tiles merge once per move, and you can keep playing past 2048. |
| 18 | **Minesweeper** | 9×9 with 8, 12 or 16 mines. Dig/Flag toggle, first tap always safe, chording, and a timer. |
| 20 | **Sudoku** | Every puzzle has exactly one solution. Easy, Medium and Hard (40, 33 and 27 clues), with hints, reset, timer and highlighting. |

### Quick-think and word
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | **Number Guess** | Guess 1–100 in 8 tries, with a narrowing range hint. |
| 11 | **Math Dash** | 30 seconds of add, subtract and multiply. A wrong answer costs 2 seconds. |
| 12 | **Higher or Lower** | Card streak game. Equal cards are a push. |
| 13 | **Color Clash** | Stroop test where you tap the ink colour, not the word. 25 seconds, and a wrong answer costs 2 seconds. |
| 21 | **Hangman** | 4 categories with 14 words each, a drawn gallows and a keyboard. Has two rare boss words (see below). |

### Versus AI
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | **Tic Tac Toe** | Minimax AI that makes the occasional mistake so it can be beaten. The starting player alternates. |
| 9 | **RPS Battle** | Rock, paper, scissors with a win/loss/draw tally. |
| 15 | **UNO** | Full 108-card deck, wild colour picker, UNO call and catch rules. Choose a **Bot IQ** (see below). |

| 19 | **Checkers** | American rules: forced captures, multi-jumps, kings. Minimax AI at 3 depths, with a 50-move draw rule. |

## AI details

**UNO Bot IQ**
- **Easy:** random legal plays and random colour picks. It sometimes forgets to call UNO, and you can catch it.
- **Medium:** saves wilds, prefers action cards, keeps its longest colour.
- **Hard:** counts unseen cards, remembers which colours you couldn't answer, and saves +4 for when you're close to winning.

local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local function notify(title, message, duration)
	local details = {
		Title = title,
		Text = message,
		Duration = duration,
		Button1 = "OK",
	}

	for _ = 1, 8 do
		if pcall(StarterGui.SetCore, StarterGui, "SendNotification", details) then
			return
		end
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	warn(title .. ": " .. message)
end

local environmentGetter = getgenv
local executorDebug = debug
local missing = {}

if type(environmentGetter) ~= "function" then
	table.insert(missing, "getgenv")
end
for _, name in { "getupvalues", "getupvalue", "setupvalue" } do
	if type(executorDebug) ~= "table" or type(executorDebug[name]) ~= "function" then
		table.insert(missing, "debug." .. name)
	end
end

if #missing > 0 then
	notify("Executor APIs Missing", "Required: " .. table.concat(missing, ", "), 20)
	return
end

local environmentOk, environment = pcall(function()
	return environmentGetter()
end)
if not environmentOk then
	notify("Executor APIs Missing", "getgenv() failed: " .. tostring(environment), 20)
	return
end
if type(environment) ~= "table" then
	notify("Executor APIs Missing", "getgenv() did not return a table.", 20)
	return
end

local upvalues = executorDebug.getupvalues
local getupvalue = executorDebug.getupvalue
local setupvalue = executorDebug.setupvalue

local previous = environment.__aimSession
if previous then
	assert(type(previous.unload) == "function", "Existing shooting hook cannot be unloaded")
	local success, reason = pcall(previous.unload, true)
	assert(success and environment.__aimSession ~= previous,
		"Could not unload the existing shooting hook: " .. tostring(reason))
end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local ClientShootable = require(ReplicatedStorage.Client.CombatController.ClientComponent.ClientShootableComponent)
local CombatController = require(ReplicatedStorage.Client.CombatController)
local CommonWeapon = require(ReplicatedStorage.Common.CombatService.CommonWeapon)
local Entities = require(ReplicatedStorage.Remote.EntityService)
local HumanoidEntity = require(ReplicatedStorage.Remote.EntityService.Entity.HumanoidEntity)
local Collision = require(ReplicatedStorage.Constant).Collision
local Combat = require(ReplicatedStorage.Config.Config).Combat

local originalShoot = ClientShootable.Shoot
local localShoot = ClientShootable.LocalShoot
assert(type(originalShoot) == "function" and type(localShoot) == "function",
	"The game's shooting functions are unavailable")

local originIndex, originalOrigin
for index, value in upvalues(originalShoot) do
	if type(value) == "function" then
		assert(originIndex == nil, "The weapon has more than one origin function")
		originIndex, originalOrigin = index, value
	end
end
assert(originIndex ~= nil, "The weapon's origin function was not found")

local localOriginMatches = 0
for _, value in upvalues(localShoot) do
	if value == originalOrigin then
		localOriginMatches += 1
	end
end
assert(localOriginMatches == 1, "LocalShoot uses a different combat origin")

local CONE_DOT = math.cos(math.rad(15))
local FIRE_INPUT = "trigger"
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.RespectCanCollide = false

local state = {
	active = true,
	enabled = true,
	triggerbot = false,
	heldWeapon = nil,
	triggerConnection = nil,
	selectedEntity = nil,
	selectedAt = -math.huge,
	preparedShot = nil,
	connections = {},
	reportedSelectionError = false,
	menuKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
	aimKey = Enum.KeyCode.V,
	triggerKey = Enum.KeyCode.T,
	deviceLabel = "Mobile",
	uiVisible = true,
	lockMouse = true,
	uiSync = nil :: (() -> ())?,
	uiDestroy = nil :: (() -> ())?,
}

local HEAD_POINTS = {
	Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
	Vector3.new(0, 0.36, 0),
	Vector3.new(-0.36, 0, 0),
	Vector3.new(0.36, 0, 0),
	Vector3.new(0, -0.36, 0),
	Vector3.new(-0.3, 0.3, 0),
	Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0),
	Vector3.new(-0.3, -0.3, 0),
	Vector3.new(0.3, -0.3, 0),
}

local BODY_PARTS = {
	Body = true, Torso = true, UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true,
	Arm = true, LeftArm = true, RightArm = true,
	LeftUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true, LeftHand = true,
	RightUpperArm = true, RightLowerArm = true, RightHand = true,
	LeftLeg = true, RightLeg = true,
	LeftUpperLeg = true, LeftLowerLeg = true, LeftFoot = true,
	RightUpperLeg = true, RightLowerLeg = true, RightFoot = true,
}

local function inspectPoint(model, part, point, origin, view, headOnly)
	local offset = point - origin
	local distance = offset.Magnitude
	if distance <= 0.01 or distance > Combat.BulletMaxDistance
		or view:Dot(offset.Unit) < CONE_DOT then
		return nil
	end

	local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, offset, rayParams)
	if headOnly then
		if hit and hit.Instance == part then
			return point, distance, part
		end
	elseif not hit or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model) then
		return point, distance, part
	end
	return nil
end

local function visiblePoint(entity, origin, view)
	local model = entity:GetModel()
	if not model or not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return nil
	end

	local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head", true)
	if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
		local frame, size = head.CFrame, head.Size
		for _, sample in HEAD_POINTS do
			local point = frame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(
				sample.X * size.X, sample.Y * size.Y, sample.Z * size.Z
			))
			local aimPoint, distance, part = inspectPoint(model, head, point, origin, view, true)
			if aimPoint then
				return aimPoint, distance, part
			end
		end
	end

	local body = entity:GetBodyPart()
	local root = entity:GetRootPart()
	for _, part in { body, root } do
		if part and part ~= head and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local aimPoint, distance, hitPart = inspectPoint(model, part, part.Position, origin, view, false)
			if aimPoint then
				return aimPoint, distance, hitPart
			end
		end
	end

	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and BODY_PARTS[part.Name] and part ~= body and part ~= root then
			local aimPoint, distance, hitPart = inspectPoint(model, part, part.Position, origin, view, false)
			if aimPoint then
				return aimPoint, distance, hitPart
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function acquireTarget(origin, view)
	local self = Entities.GetLocalEntity()
	if not self or not self:IsAlive() then
		return nil
	end
	local group = self:GetCollision(Collision.Attack)
	if type(group) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end

	rayParams.CollisionGroup = group
	local character = self:GetWorkspaceRoot()
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = character and { character } or {}

	local function isHostile(entity)
		return entity ~= self and HumanoidEntity:is(entity)
			and entity:IsAlive() and not self:IsFriendly(entity)
	end

	if state.selectedEntity and os.clock() - state.selectedAt <= 0.22
		and isHostile(state.selectedEntity) then
		local point, distance, part = visiblePoint(state.selectedEntity, origin, view)
		if point then
			return state.selectedEntity, point, distance, part
		end
	end

	local closestEntity, closestPoint, closestDistance, closestPart
	closestDistance = Combat.BulletMaxDistance
	for _, entity in Entities.Entity.GetAll() do
		if isHostile(entity) then
			local point, distance, part = visiblePoint(entity, origin, view)
			if point and distance < closestDistance then
				closestEntity, closestPoint, closestDistance, closestPart = entity, point, distance, part
			end
		end
	end
	return closestEntity, closestPoint, closestDistance, closestPart
end

local function reportSelectionError(reason)
	if not state.reportedSelectionError then
		state.reportedSelectionError = true
		warn("Target selection failed: " .. tostring(reason))
	end
end

local function redirectedOrigin(...)
	local origin, detectedAt, cameraData = originalOrigin(...)
	if not (state.active and state.enabled and typeof(origin) == "CFrame") then
		return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
	end

	if state.preparedShot == false then
		return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
	end

	local entity, point
	if state.preparedShot then
		entity, point = state.preparedShot.entity, state.preparedShot.point
	else
		local success, selected, selectedPoint = pcall(acquireTarget, origin.Position, origin.LookVector)
		if not success then
			reportSelectionError(selected)
			return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
		end
		entity, point = selected, selectedPoint
	end

	if not point then
		return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
	end
	local offset = point - origin.Position
	if offset.Magnitude <= 0.001 or origin.LookVector:Dot(offset.Unit) < CONE_DOT then
		return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
	end

	state.selectedEntity = entity
	state.selectedAt = os.clock()
	return CFrame.lookAt(origin.Position, point), detectedAt, cameraData
end

local function runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, prepared)
	state.preparedShot = prepared
	local success, result = pcall(originalShoot, component, start, direction, context)
	state.preparedShot = nil
	if not success then
		error(result, 0)
	end
	return result
end

local function shootWithTarget(component, start, direction, context)
	if not (state.active and state.enabled) then
		return originalShoot(component, start, direction, context)
	end

	local success, origin = pcall(originalOrigin)
	if not success or typeof(origin) ~= "CFrame" then
		return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, false)
	end

	local selected, entity, point, _, part = pcall(acquireTarget, origin.Position, origin.LookVector)
	if not selected then
		reportSelectionError(entity)
		return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, false)
	end
	if not entity or not point then
		return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, false)
	end

	local pivot = entity:GetPivot(true)
	local offset = point - origin.Position
	if not pivot or offset.Magnitude <= 0.001 or origin.LookVector:Dot(offset.Unit) < CONE_DOT then
		return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, false)
	end

	local shotContext = context or {}
	shotContext.Target = entity.Instance
	shotContext.TargetPos = pivot:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	shotContext.TargetHeadshot = part ~= nil and part.Name == "Head"
	return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, shotContext, { entity = entity, point = point })
end

local function releaseTrigger()
	local held = state.heldWeapon
	state.heldWeapon = nil
	if held then
		local shooter = held._Shootable
		if shooter and shooter.StopShootingTimer then
			local success, reason = pcall(shooter.StopShootingTimer, shooter, { Input = FIRE_INPUT })
			if not success then
				warn("Could not stop firing: " .. tostring(reason))
			end
		end
	end
end

local function hasTargetInCrosshair(entity, origin)
	local model = entity:GetModel()
	if not model then
		return false
	end
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin.Position, origin.LookVector * Combat.BulletMaxDistance, rayParams)
	return hit ~= nil and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model)
end

local function checkTrigger()
	if not state.active or not state.triggerbot then
		releaseTrigger()
		return
	end

	if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
		releaseTrigger()
		return
	end

	local weapon = CombatController.GetWeapon()
	local shooter = weapon and weapon._Shootable
	if not (weapon and weapon.Activated and shooter and not shooter.Destroyed) then
		releaseTrigger()
		return
	end

	local origin = originalOrigin()
	if typeof(origin) ~= "CFrame" then
		releaseTrigger()
		return
	end

	local entity = acquireTarget(origin.Position, origin.LookVector)
	if not entity or (not state.enabled and not hasTargetInCrosshair(entity, origin)) then
		releaseTrigger()
		return
	end

	local automatic = shooter:IsFullAuto()
	if state.heldWeapon and (state.heldWeapon ~= weapon or not automatic) then
		releaseTrigger()
	end
	if automatic then
		if state.heldWeapon then
			return
		end
		if not (shooter:CanShoot() and shooter:CanShootNow()) then
			return
		end
		if weapon:CanAction(CommonWeapon.Action.Primary) then
			if CombatController.PrimaryAction.Begin(FIRE_INPUT) then
				state.heldWeapon = weapon
			end
		end
		return
	end

	if shooter:CanShoot() and shooter:CanShootNow() and weapon:CanAction(CommonWeapon.Action.Primary) then
		CombatController.PrimaryAction.Begin(FIRE_INPUT)
	end
end

local function runTrigger()
	local success, reason = pcall(checkTrigger)
	if not success then
		state.triggerbot = false
		local sync = state.uiSync
		if sync then
			sync()
		end
		if state.triggerConnection then
			state.triggerConnection:Disconnect()
			state.triggerConnection = nil
		end
		releaseTrigger()
		warn("Triggerbot stopped: " .. tostring(reason))
		notify("Triggerbot", "Stopped: " .. tostring(reason), 8)
	end
end

local function setTriggerbot(enabled)
	state.triggerbot = enabled
	if enabled then
		if not state.triggerConnection then
			state.triggerConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(runTrigger)
		end
	else
		if state.triggerConnection then
			state.triggerConnection:Disconnect()
			state.triggerConnection = nil
		end
		releaseTrigger()
	end
end

local deviceReport

local function restoreDeviceReport()
	local saved = deviceReport
	if not saved then
		return
	end
	deviceReport = nil
	if saved.connection then saved.connection:Disconnect() end

	local actualDevice = saved.input.Device
	if type(actualDevice) == "string" and actualDevice ~= state.deviceLabel then
		local ok, reason = pcall(function()
			saved.remote:FireServer(actualDevice)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("Could not restore device report: " .. tostring(reason))
		end
	end
end

local function enableDeviceReport()
	if deviceReport then
		return
	end
	local input = require(ReplicatedStorage.Client.InputHelper)
	local devices = require(ReplicatedStorage.Constant).Device
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage.Remote.Any.Device
	local changed = input.Event and input.Event.DeviceChanged
	assert(changed and type(changed.Connect) == "function", "DeviceChanged signal is unavailable")
	assert(type(remote.FireServer) == "function", "Device reporting is unavailable")
	assert(type(devices[state.deviceLabel]) == "string", "Reported device is unavailable")

	local saved = {
		input = input, remote = remote, devices = devices,
		warned = false, report = function() end,
		connection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
	}
	local function report()
		if not state.active or deviceReport ~= saved then
			return
		end
		local ok, reason = pcall(function()
			remote:FireServer(devices[state.deviceLabel])
		end)
		if not ok and not saved.warned then
			saved.warned = true
			warn("Could not report device: " .. tostring(reason))
		end
	end
	saved.report = report
	saved.connection = changed:Connect(report)
	deviceReport = saved
	report()
end

local function buildPanel()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local playerGui = player and player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
	assert(playerGui, "PlayerGui is unavailable")

	local colour = {
		base = Color3.fromRGB(23, 27, 33),
		inner = Color3.fromRGB(31, 36, 44),
		raised = Color3.fromRGB(43, 50, 60),
		border = Color3.fromRGB(73, 82, 95),
		text = Color3.fromRGB(241, 244, 247),
		muted = Color3.fromRGB(153, 164, 177),
		accent = Color3.fromRGB(85, 207, 173),
		active = Color3.fromRGB(31, 78, 69),
		alert = Color3.fromRGB(226, 120, 115),
	}
	local images = {
		main = "rbxassetid://83752373575368",
		settings = "rbxassetid://106205298246017",
		minimise = "rbxassetid://95070996149109",
		power = "rbxassetid://89331085993646",
		check = "rbxassetid://86817768619372",
	}
	local controls = {}
	local bindings = {}
	local uiConnections = {}
	local activePress = nil
	local capturing = nil :: string?
	local dragging = nil
	local pointerStart = Vector2.zero
	local popupOpen = false
	local cursor = { bound = false, behavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default, iconVisible = true }
	local cursorStep = "ys.menu.cursor." .. tostring(player.UserId)

	local function connect(signal, callback)
		local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
		table.insert(uiConnections, connection)
		return connection
	end

	local function create(class, parent, values)
		local item = Instance.new(class)
		for key, value in values do
			item[key] = value
		end
		item.Parent = parent
		return item
	end

	local function round(parent, radius)
		create("UICorner", parent, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) })
	end

	local function icon(parent, image, x, y, size, tint, z)
		return create("ImageLabel", parent, {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = image, ImageColor3 = tint or colour.muted,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ZIndex = z or 1,
		})
	end

	local function label(parent, content, x, y, width, height, size, tint, bold)
		return create("TextLabel", parent, {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = content, TextSize = size,
			Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextColor3 = tint or colour.text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
		})
	end

	local screen = create("ScreenGui", playerGui, {
		Name = "YSHub", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = false,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, DisplayOrder = 10000,
	})
	local uiRoot = gethui
	if type(uiRoot) == "function" then
		local ok, root = pcall(uiRoot)
		if ok and typeof(root) == "Instance" then
			pcall(function() screen.Parent = root end)
		end
	end
	local modal = create("TextButton", screen, {
		Name = "MouseInput", Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AutoButtonColor = false, Modal = true, Active = true, ZIndex = 0,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Visible = false,
	})
	local function releaseMouse()
		modal.Visible = false
		if not cursor.bound then return end
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(cursorStep)
		cursor.bound = false
		-- The Roblox pause menu owns the cursor while it is open.
		if not GuiService.MenuIsOpen then
			if UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.Default then
				UserInputService.MouseBehavior = cursor.behavior
			end
			UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = cursor.iconVisible
		end
		cursor.behavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		cursor.iconVisible = true
	end
	local function updateMouse()
		local useCursor = state.active and state.uiVisible and state.lockMouse
			and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		if not useCursor then
			releaseMouse()
			return
		end
		modal.Visible = true
		if cursor.bound then return end

		state.connections[index]:Disconnect()
		state.connections[index] = nil
	end
	restoreDeviceReport()

	if ClientShootable.Shoot == shootWithTarget then
		ClientShootable.Shoot = originalShoot
	else
		warn("Shoot changed externally; original function was not restored")
	end
	if getupvalue(originalShoot, originIndex) == redirectedOrigin then
		setupvalue(originalShoot, originIndex, originalOrigin)
	else
		warn("Combat origin changed externally; original function was not restored")
	end
	if environment.__aimSession == state then
		environment.__aimSession = nil
	end
	if not silent then
		notify("YS - SNIPER ARENA", "Unloaded", 5)
	end
end

local taken = {}
local function savedKey(field, fallback)
	local candidate = previous and previous[field]
	if typeof(candidate) ~= "EnumItem" or tostring(candidate.EnumType) ~= "Enum.KeyCode"
		or candidate.Name == "Unknown" or candidate.Name == "End"
		or candidate.Name == "Escape" or taken[candidate.Name] then
		candidate = fallback
	end
	-- F6 was the old default, not an intentional custom binding.
	if field == "aimKey" and candidate.Name == "F6" then candidate = Enum.KeyCode.V end
	if taken[candidate.Name] then
		for _, option in { Enum.KeyCode.RightShift, Enum.KeyCode.V, Enum.KeyCode.T, Enum.KeyCode.B } do
			if not taken[option.Name] then
				candidate = option
				break
			end
		end
	end
	taken[candidate.Name] = true
	return candidate
end
